text:
Jamal - New Hire: Hi team 1 1 Just got my MacBook Pro (M2). Followed the quickstart but I don't see the Redwood MDM profile under System Settings > Profiles. Also system warns "This Mac is not encrypted" when I try to enable FileVault. Any tips?
Priya - IT: Welcome Jamal! Quick checklist: did you accept the "Company Setup" prompt during first boot and sign in with your Okta account? If you skipped, the MDM enrollment won't complete.
Jamal - New Hire: I think I tapped "Skip" on one of the screens because I rushed. Is it possible to rerun enrollment without re-imaging?
Onboard Bot: Automated checklist created: ONB-778. Please do not re-image unless instructed.
Ken (EngInfra): You can trigger enrollment from the device without reimaging: open Terminal and run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` then check `profiles status -type enrollment`. Paste results here.
Jamal - New Hire: Ran those commands, here's output: `profiles: No enrolled profiles`
Ken (EngInfra): OK that means the device never finished the DEP/Automated Enrollment handshake. Two paths: (A) we can initiate a remote enrollment using the serial via Jamf, or (B) you can remove the local user and go through Setup Assistant again to re-run DEP flow. I'd prefer (A). Can you share your Mac serial?
Jamal - New Hire: Serial is W0X1Y2Z3ABC4
Priya - IT: Got it. I'll open a Jamf re-enroll for that serial. Also, for FileVault: we enforce encryption via MDM profile. Until the profile lands you won't be able to enable FileVault manually. For Docker and dev tools, we can grant temporary local admin. Maya, can you approve?
Maya (People Ops): Approve temporary admin for Jamal for 6 hours while they finish onboarding. Please confirm manager approval in thread.
Jamal - New Hire: Manager is Priya (yep she is my manager). Thanks!
Priya - IT: Approved and created temp admin account mapping to your Okta user. Logout/login should show admin privileges. Use `sudo` for any installs.
Ken (EngInfra): Jamf re-enroll pushed at 14:42 UTC. If the device has network and APNS configured it should pull within ~5 minutes. If not, run `sudo jamf mdm` (if jamf binary present) or reboot.
Jamal - New Hire: Rebooted, saw a "Remote Management" prompt this time and accepted. `profiles status -type enrollment` now shows an MDM profile.
Ken (EngInfra): Nice. Next step: the security profile will push FileVault enable command and escrow the recovery key to our key manager. On some macOS versions it will require a user to restart to trigger the enable flow. Restart when you can.
Jamal - New Hire: Restarted, system restarted into login and now I get a "FileVault is being enabled" message.
Onboard Bot: ONB-778 updated: MDM applied, FileVault enabling. Temporary admin scheduled to auto-revoke in 6 hours.
Jamal - New Hire: Docker and dev tools installed fine using sudo. One small annoyance: Homebrew install asked to create /opt/homebrew which my temp admin covered. All good.
Priya - IT: We'll verify the recovery key is escrowed in Jamf. If you see any prompts about local users needing enabling for disk encryption, ping me.
Jamal - New Hire: Everything looks green on my end. Huge thanks 1 :partyparrot:
Ken (EngInfra): Follow-up: we added an onboarding doc link for self-service re-enroll in the internal Handbook (handbook.redwood/infrastructure/mac-mdm). If anyone hits this again, follow that flow first.
Maya (People Ops): Welcome again Jamal! Closing onboarding ticket ONB-778 in 24h if no further issues.
Jamal - New Hire: Appreciate it folks. All set for day 1 dev tasks :)
